options.label: 'Could be disconnected to' — points FROM target TO possible precursors
A forward reaction, equivalent to the normal reaction arrow (→)
Equilibrium between the two sides, like a reversible arrow
Resonance between two representations of the same molecule

explanation: The retro arrow (⇒) points FROM the target TO its precursors. It asks: 'what simpler molecules could I combine to form this bond?' The ACTUAL synthesis goes in the opposite direction (precursors → target with →). Retrosynthesis is a planning tool; the reaction only runs forward.
